plain_english: God of gods, great god — fully content am I, Śaṅkara: the essence of the Rudrayāmala-tantra, today held.
sanskrit_cite: devadeva māhadeva paritṛptāsmi śaṅkara | rudrayāmalatantrasya sāram adyāvadhāritam

plain_english: Of all the power-divisions, the heart known today, and: having spoken thus, delighted, the goddess on the neck — clung to Śiva's.
sanskrit_cite: sarvaśaktiprabhedānāṃ hṛdayaṃ jñātam adya ca | ity uktvānanditā devi ka.ṅthe lagnā śivasya tu
